svg.title: Three lock granularities for booking seats: one lock, a lock per seat, lock-free compare-and-set
svg.desc: Three threads: T1 and T3 want seat 1, T2 wants seat 4. With one lock for all seats, T2 and T3 both wait. With a lock per seat, only T3 waits, behind T1. With compare-and-set, nobody waits: T3 fails at once and can pick another seat.
svg.text: T2 waits for T1 though seat 4 is free
only T3 waits: it wants the seat T1 is booking
nobody waits: T3 gets "taken" at once and picks another
